name: kick
description: Full-english lengthwise kick: a rolling ball driven straight into the foot (short) rail with maximum right english; the rebound drifts ~2.8-2.9 diamonds across the table by the time it returns to the head rail (SC-002 spec window 3 +/- 0.3). Demonstrates cushion speed/spin coupling (feel four-pack item 3). Drift = (x at head-rail contact - (-0.45)) / 0.3175 diamonds.
provenance: Geometry and shot constants from crates/pool-core/tests/fixtures/anchors/kick.json (lengthwise_geometry; Dr. Dave bank-kick FAQ 1/2/3-diamond anchor, gap-k66 sec 3/5): start (-0.45, -1.2), phi = pi/2 into the foot rail, v0 = 2 m/s, full english a = 0.5 (the miscue limit). Measured kernel drift 2.8031 diamonds (Han/Stronge), 2.9329 (Mathavan preset).
